“行星边界”（planetary boundaries）框架包含哪几类阈值？

What categories of thresholds does the planetary boundaries framework contain?

涵盖气候变化、生物多样性丧失、氮磷循环、土地系统变化、淡水、海洋酸化、大气气溶胶、化学污染、平流层臭氧等九项，其中数项已被越过，提示地球系统风险。
It covers climate change, biosphere integrity, biogeochemical flows (N/P), land-system change, freshwater, ocean acidification, aerosols, novel chemicals and stratospheric ozone—several already crossed, signaling Earth-system risk.

什么是“真实进步指标”（GPI），它和GDP有何不同？

What is the Genuine Progress Indicator (GPI) and how does it differ from GDP?

GPI在GDP基础上扣除环境退化、社会成本（如污染医疗、通勤、不平等），并加上志愿等非市场收益，试图衡量“真实”福祉而非单纯产出。
GPI starts from GDP but subtracts environmental degradation and social costs (pollution health bills, commuting, inequality) and adds non-market benefits like volunteering, aiming to measure real well-being, not just output.

什么是“生态足迹”和“生物承载力”？

What are 'ecological footprint' and 'biocapacity'?

生态足迹衡量人类消耗资源与吸纳废物所需的生物生产性土地面积；生物承载力是地球（或区域）实际能提供的。前者超过后者即“生态超载”。
Ecological footprint measures the biologically productive area needed for our resource use and waste absorption; biocapacity is what Earth (or a region) can actually provide. Footprint exceeding capacity is 'ecological overshoot'.
